Joan: Hi team — prepping Dedicated pool for NovaHealth next week. Need to lock quota, set autoscale min/max, and run smoke load test Wed 09:00 PST. Can SRE/ML confirm GPU counts, warmup plan, and a rollback cadence? @Liam @Pat @Sara

Liam: Got it. Reservation currently 8xA100 (v4). Recommend autoscale min=2 max=8, burst buffer +2 for warmup. I'll patch the policy and update the slot. ETA ~30m.

Pat: For model warmup, we'll prepopulate KV cache and run a small prefix replay. Proposed warmup command:
```
python tools/warmup.py --model redwood-7b --prefix-file tests/prefixes.json --tokens 50k --concurrency 4
```
This seeds embedding caches too. Plan ~15m of warmup before smoke.

Sara: Confirming from NovaHealth — test pattern: baseline 250 TPS, spike 400 TPS for 5m every 15m. 95p latency target <= 200ms end-to-end. We'll have 2 engineers on call and Slack bridge ready.

Joan: Awesome. Can we run smoke Wed 09:00 PST and full soak Thu 02:00 UTC? Also need billing quoter locked at agreed cap so we don't surprise accounts. @finance FYI

Liam: deploy-bot reserved slot: slot-17701 for 2025-06-12T09:00:00Z. I'll attach the runbook and set CloudWatch alarms: GPU_util > 75% for 2m, queue_depth > 50. I'll also enable a rollback window of 15m with auto-fallback to hosted model variant.

Pat: Also adding sample load script for the runner:
```
wrk -t16 -c400 -d30m --latency https://api.redwood-inference.test/v1/generate -H 'X-Client: novahealth-staging'
```
Start with canary (5% traffic) then ramp 25/50/100. Note: enable KV prefix caching and disable large-batch quantization for the soak.

Sara: Thanks — we'll run canary traffic first (5% for 10m) then ramp as Pat suggested. Also expecting a config tweak: model quantization to q4_0 enabled for the cost run only. We'll capture cost delta.

Joan: I'll coordinate post-test notes and feedback capture. Please paste any anomalies in #cs-postmortems and tag me. :thumbsup:
